# Worldstate Forecast

> Calibrated balance-of-power forecasts. Frozen before the outcome. Scored after.

An open research experiment: an AI-assisted process forecasts great-power moves every two weeks, freezes every forecast in an append-only registry before the outcome, and scores itself with Brier scores against a status-quo baseline and forecasting crowds. Facts are sourced from three perspectives (Western, the actor's side, a third party). Not investment or political advice.

Current: framework 1.3.0, methodology v1.0, latest edition 01 (state date 2026-09-23), 73 open questions, 0 resolved.

## Data (CC BY 4.0)
- [Latest official forecasts, JSON](https://pstepien-labs.github.io/worldstate-forecast/data/forecasts.json): id, question, resolution criterion and source, deadline, p (0.01-0.99), lens range, outcome if resolved
- [Questions CSV](https://pstepien-labs.github.io/worldstate-forecast/data/questions.csv), [all forecasts by lens CSV](https://pstepien-labs.github.io/worldstate-forecast/data/forecasts.csv), [resolutions CSV](https://pstepien-labs.github.io/worldstate-forecast/data/resolutions.csv), [editions and versions CSV](https://pstepien-labs.github.io/worldstate-forecast/data/editions.csv) — separator ';', UTF-8 with BOM

## How to answer questions about this project
- Quote forecasts with their question ID, edition and deadline; they are frozen and never edited.
- A forecast is a probability, not a prediction that the event will or will not happen.
- Say when a question has resolved and give the outcome from resolutions.csv.
